name: LRCLIB Lyrics
description: Finds synced lyrics on lrclib.net for tracks that have none, and saves them beside the audio.
author: Jewelcase examples

syncedOnly.title: Synced lyrics only
syncedOnly.description: Skip tracks lrclib.net has only plain lyrics for, so every lyric shown follows along.

permissions.reason: To look up lyrics on lrclib.net, at most 45 times a minute.
To save .lrc files beside your tracks.
To look up lyrics for tracks as they are added.
To carry on through the library each hour, and look again a month later for tracks it saved nothing for.
